scope: Ordinary narrowed IQ1_S and IQ1_M tiny-fixture HF checks only. These are preintegration feature-source results using the retained earlier-built product; they do not qualify the integrated source, released models, performance, or landing.

product.note: Retained binary built before integration. The embedded version is not an exact source-revision proof; the product hash identifies the tested executable.

case_counts: Each format in each run: 150 full-logit cases and 12 NLL checks across dense-untied, dense-tied and MoE fixtures.

runs.interpretation: The output uses the f16-family bounds, and the HF test policy falls back to those bounds for an int8 request without a block-int8 witness. This log does not itself serialize the matrix-path witness, so it is not evidence of native block-int8 execution.

shared_output: Each HF log also reports exact IQ1_S and IQ1_M CLI conversion for 180,224 field values per format, including multi-block rows and empty rows/models.
preserved_f32_evidence: The earlier ordinary F32 results remain in iq1-initial-operators-20261023.json; this record does not replace them.
limitations: No released-model, long-context, MX Vulkan, performance, or existing-path regression qualification is included.
No current integrated-source build or test result is claimed.
